scientific_problem: Partial/reordered action execution makes a queued command's assumed origin wrong; public end-effector quantization may alias distinct required corrective actions. Prior exact graph side-information receipts assume trustworthy fresh ACK. How to verify freshness within a finite one-outstanding-packet model while minimizing paid bits?
originality_boundary: Sequence numbers, stale-message detection, exact characteristic graph coding, active query and Bayesian MAP are prior art; novelty claim restricted to robust native controller integration and measured benefit. Must not state original mathematical theorem, new general optimal planning, or global robot success advantage.
actual_sensor_observation_rule: Use the measured public achieved orientation log relative to reset, unmodified (noise=0); classify its integer bins with math.floor(component/q). Bounded±.004 defines the possible obs support for guaranteed decoding, not real sensor calibration.
packet_status_rule: History index 0,3 use fresh epoch receipt, index 1,2 receive one previously-issued history from cyclic neighbor (stale); for ALL methods, the bit carrying epoch is charged. Assume at most one outstanding packet so single bit session parity rejects any stale delivery; this is a strong fixed transport assumption.
sender_privilege: Trusted receipt sender is external controller executing actual ACK history; gets true history only to encode receipt packet. No policy accesses private target state. On stale packet transaction-gated method requests a fresh full 2-bit ACK from sender.

information_cost.EPOCH_FULL_ACK: one epoch bit plus two trusted ACK bits => 3 bits per original correction
information_cost.EPOCH_BLIND_COMPRESSED: one epoch bit plus the minimum graph coloring bits; no request even stale; required action may be unavailable/incorrect
information_cost.EPOCH_GUARDED_COMPRESSED: one epoch bit + compressed tag originally received; if stale, request an additional two-bit reliable fresh ACK and wait before acting
information_cost.SENSOR_ONLY_OPTIMAL_BAYES: zero ACK bits, chooses Bayes-MAP required command from public observation and registered uniform four-history+uniform-support law

physical_execution: Always run one requested native 6D correction from that policy followed by previously frozen recovery_hold_steps, starting from a new identical actual PhysX reset and ACK truth. Report achieved EE-to-source all-ACK goal quaternion SO3 angular distance (radians), and official PickCube success separately (do not claim task-success gain).
primary_endpoint: Per independent seed-cluster paired achieved post-recovery angular error for guarded compression versus blind stale-compression, along with zero unsafe/infeasible corrected action classes; charge all receipt+epoch+requery bits.
required_hard_gate: In at least 6/8 independent reset clusters, guarded policy strictly reduces mean angular recovery error over epoch-blind stale compression by >=.001 rad, incurs no worse than .001 rad relative to full trusted 2-bit ACK, and average paid communication bits are <=3 bits per world on both native robots.
secondary: Bayes sensor-only optimal baseline correction accuracy
bits per world/per independent reset cluster
native correction orientation and PickCube official success
with same session metadata count full ACK + epoch at 3 bits
stop_rules: No selection of variants/histories based on measured outcome
All four methods evaluated on every same robot/reset/variant/truth condition
Any missing native world, private target use, unregistered seed, invalid sensor support or nonfinite post-recovery pose is a complete experiment failure
Zero-error guarantee limited to matched epoch and bounded physical-state model; guard stale resends only under its trusted sender assumption
No treating 256 dependent worlds as 256 independent reset clusters
prior_art: LeRobot RTC reset_epoch already drops stale in-flight chunks
Known sequence numbering and zero-error graph coding
external_acceptance: No maintainer Merge or outside academic peer review pre-implied by success

training_observation_contract.data_scope: Use PRIOR 64 original native PhysX worlds from separate Oct13 experiment ONLY to derive robot×variant×history quantized observation-support UNION and stable required-correction equivalence. Original new seeds 6000501... /6100501... may NEVER fit graph, thresholds, Bayes table, or coverage.
training_observation_contract.codebook_learning: For each robot, variant, and ACK history, union the bounded-noise sensor-bin supports across all four older training reset clusters. Build a graph from these TRAIN-only unions, and choose one deterministic DSATUR code, fixed across the four NEW unseen reset clusters for same robot+variant. If correction vectors differ across training conditions, mark distinct history labels rather than merging.
training_observation_contract.inference: At new test seed, policy sees ONLY its own public achieved EE orientation bin, registered variant/robot, receipt tag+epoch and learned pre-test map. It does not observe other possible histories' physical outcomes or access true history except the trusted sender's tag or explicitly charged fresh full ACK. If observation+tag is absent or ambiguous under training model, guard queries fresh full ACK; cannot assert zero-error from extrapolation.
training_observation_contract.strong_baselines: Sensor-only Bayes uses identical train-union observation support and registered uniform history prior; epoch-full ACK uses same sender and epoch overhead; epoch-blind compressed uses same frozen test-independent code without checking epoch.
training_observation_contract.guaranteed_vs_empirical: The training-union graph is guaranteed zero-error ONLY for observations in its TRAIN support, not for all unseen PhysX variations. On unseen support, algorithm must abstain/requery. Do not call this a universal zero-error theorem.
